verdict.rationale: Algolia's llms.txt lists AI Search (NeuralSearch) as hosted hybrid keyword + vector semantic search, and the probe describes 'AI-powered semantic' search. This implies Algolia handles vectorization itself, but no evidence explicitly says documents and queries are embedded automatically without a user-run pipeline. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of managed/built-in embedding for records and queries, details on embedder models or configuration, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
